# gezor_clusters (Data Source)

All clusters in a workspace.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "gezor_clusters" "all" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `workspace` (String) Workspace id or slug. Defaults to the provider's `workspace`.
